title: Brackenridge Hospital Real Estate Talks
summary:
*   A special, brief meeting was held, with active discussion lasting less than an hour.
*   The primary activity was a closed-door Executive Session.
*   Council members privately discussed potential real estate transactions related to Brackenridge Hospital.
*   No public hearings were conducted, and no open policy decisions were made during this session.
